title: E-MTR-0015: the g of the spinor token, a STAND-IN, read by spin sector: at $k_z = 0$ the walk conserves S = tau_x...
purpose: Experiment E-MTR-0015 in the spin arena: the g of the spinor token, a STAND-IN, read by spin sector: at $k_z = 0$ the walk conserves S = tau_x sigma_z, the spin along the field, so its Landau ladders separate exactly, and g is read from where each ladder starts against the rest energy, beside a light-coin Dirac walk that must read 2 and a spectator walk that must read 0.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
